name: Zichri
overview: Zichri was a male member of the tribe of Reuben, known primarily as the father of Eliezer. His identity is grounded in this familial connection as recorded in 1 Chronicles 27:16. There are no additional notes or significant details about his life beyond this relationship.
namesAndTitles: The name Zichri means 'YHWH remembers' in Hebrew, indicating a meaning centered on God's remembrance. This proper name is not explicitly stated to be given by God, but it reflects a theologically significant concept common in biblical names.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Zichri as the father of Eliezer and a descendant of the tribe of Reuben. These family ties are explicitly stated in 1 Chronicles 27:16. No other family relationships are recorded beyond these.
scriptureSignificance: Zichri's biblical significance lies chiefly in his role as the father of Eliezer, situating him within the genealogical and tribal framework of Israel. His mention in 1 Chronicles 27:16 connects him to the organization of the tribes during King David's reign, underscoring the importance of lineage and tribal identity in God's providential plan. Though not a prominent figure in narrative events, his inclusion preserves the heritage of the tribe of Reuben in the biblical record.
